caption_L1: Gross domestic product (GDP) of England in the United Kingdom (UK) 2000 - 2018 (in trillion GBP) is a line plot. The x-axis shows Year using a linear scale from 2000 to 2015. A linear scale with a minimum of 0.0 and a maximum of 2.0 can be seen on the y-axis, marked GDP in trillion GBP.
caption_L2L3: There has been an overall gradual increase in GDP between the years of 2000 and 2018. Between 2005 and 2010, there was a decrease in GDP at around 2008-2009. This then increased again after 2010.
